ulp_bound.derivation: delta a <= 4u*a_max; delta det <= |c|*delta a + u*|a*c| <= 5u|c|; delta t = delta det/(2*a*sqrt(det)); delta depth = |v_z|*delta t + u*depth; Delta ULP(px) = [5u|c| |v_z| / (2 a sqrt(det))] / ULP(depth); with conservative |c|max=4.2, |v_z|max=1, a_min=1-4u, sqrt(det)_min=3.4e-2, ULP(1.2)=1.19e-7 => ~110 ULP, times 1.15 safety rounded up to a power of two => 128
ulp_bound.final_value_policy: recomputed at freeze with the exact sqrt(det)_min and |c|max from the frozen ray grid using the same formula; if the recomputation exceeds 128 the attempt fails (temporary relaxation of B is forbidden)

fail_closed: pixels outside the frozen list: depth must be bitwise equal, else fail

the frozen pixel set itself must match pixel-for-pixel (extra or missing pixel = fail)
list file is frozen and hashed with the guards; rewriting it inside the window is forbidden
seg stays exact for all pixels; rgb stays <= 1 LSB; the SDF entity stays bitwise (section 1)
manually raising B or deleting pixels is a violation => the round fails
